credits.title: People Pleaser: Si Paling Gak Enakan
credits.overview: Karina is a young woman who always puts others first and finds it difficult to say "no." This habit leaves her exhausted and causes her to sacrifice her own dreams.

credits.title: Cerita Lila
credits.overview: Following a fatal history of severe maternal domestic abuse, the discarnate spirit of a young twin navigates the afterlife in a desperate search for her separated sister, uncovering a clandestine metaphysical conspiracy designed to obscure the truth of their deaths.

credits.title: Pamali: The Little Devil
credits.overview: When Putri's mother suddenly disappeared mysteriously, she decided to trace the available clues to find her mother again, starting from walking through a haunter forest, an abandoned factory, until arriving at an old house which turned out to be inhabited by "tuyul" and the terrifying black "kuntilanak".

credits.title: Thaghut

credits.title: Father's Haunted House

credits.title: Devil's Horns
credits.overview: Birth and death occur when the devil's horns rise. The terror of waiting for the birth of a child from a pre-pregnant marriage and the 14 day wait for death due to an implant that had not been removed.

credits.title: The Devil’s Cult
credits.overview: A pair of twins come to a remote village to find out the cause of their father's strange death, but they end up trapped in a dangerous village full of terror.

credits.title: Pamali: The Corpse Village
credits.overview: A group of medical volunteers who are sent to a remote village to help residents affected by a deadly epidemic while keeping many secrets related to Pamali.

credits.title: Pamali
credits.overview: While visiting an old family home, a married couple unintentionally breaks local taboos that invite a series of tormenting events.

credits.title: Eyang Putri
credits.overview: Tells the story of a brother and sister who finally decide to take care of their grandparents who turns out to be keeping a sinister secret which, in fact, the longer the secret is kept, the more often they are terrorized by the unseen.

credits.title: Bunda: Kisah Cinta 2 Kodi
credits.overview: A woman with two children is faced with a choice between her family or a business in Muslim clothing for children.
